title: CASSANALYTICS-124 Commitlog reading not progressing in CDC due to incorrect CommitLogReader.isFullyRead
notes: First Analytics case (2 files, +40/-7; small tier). Head is the landed trunk commit (squash of PR #176). The hard issue is from CASSANALYTICS-127 (created 2026-03-10, the day after the case landed), whose description names commit 34c6c382 as the cause, and its fix commit 2427d27: the block added after the sync-segment loop sets position to log.maxOffset() whenever statusTracker.shouldContinue(), without checking that the segment was complete, so a commit log still being written is marked fully read (isFullyRead true) and later mutations in it are never read; it also broke CdcTests.testMockedCdc. Lines at the head: BufferingCommitLogReader.java:321-326. The file is in cassandra-four-zero-bridge (a copy of Cassandra's commit log reader). Training contamination: post-dates the case head; recheck per model. First panel run (2026-11-20, Sonnet): found by cass-concurrency-lifecycle (cl-2, line 325).

known_issues.summary: After the loop, position is set to log.maxOffset() without checking the segment is complete, so an incomplete commit log is marked fully read
